description: This Java class provides a no-operation implementation of resource limit checks, always returning false indicating that resource limits are never reached.

classes.name: NoopResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: A class implementing ResourceLimitChecks that always indicates resource limits are not reached.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Returns a Future indicating the connection limit has not been reached (always false).

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Returns a Future indicating the message limit has not been reached (always false).
